name: Manage Account Settings
summary: Access and manage account settings including handle, verification, backup, privacy, and permissions

steps.title: Home screen
steps.description: Main dashboard showing Total balance $0.00, quick action buttons (Add money, Send, Convert), yield promo card, and bottom tab bar.

steps.title: Settings
steps.description: Settings screen showing truncated wallet address (0x93d...Ce569) with 'NOT VERIFIED' badge and Receive button. General section: Account Handle (AVAILABLE), Verification, Account Backup (BACKUP NEEDED), Account Privacy, Permissions. Security section: Keys & Security. About section: Get Help.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed settings screen. Tab bar hidden. Back chevron top-left.

steps.title: Account Handle
steps.description: Choose your handle screen with text input showing '@Satoshi'. Green Continue button below. Keyboard visible.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed handle picker. Input focused with keyboard.

steps.title: Identity Verification
steps.description: Verify your identity prompt — 'Takes 2 min' badge. Explains verification unlocks Tuyo Card and banking features.

steps.title: Backup
steps.description: Backup screen showing iCloud Drive as NOT CONNECTED. Explains Tuyo stores private key via iCloud Keychain, with encrypted secondary backup on iCloud Drive.

steps.title: Privacy
steps.description: Privacy settings with single toggle: 'Hide Holdings & Earn Balances' (currently off).

steps.title: Permissions
steps.description: Permissions screen with two toggles: Biometrics (off) and Push Notifications (on, green).

notes: Steps 3-7 are each accessed from the Settings screen (step 2). They are branches, not a sequential flow.
